geometry: Enclosed attic with deep continuous rakes, a recessed pierced cast facing, solid raised volutes/paired fluted leaves, carried pendents, separate coffers and slimmer full-depth inner trusses.

Six primary and five intermediate front eave heads use complementary half-lapped crossed arms, flared dou, two continuous raking tails and fitted purlin seats, each bounded by the shared physical hip-apron roof equation.
4,736 separate overlapping closed half-round cover shells replace full cylindrical roof rods; existing closed pan tiles, ridge/eave envelope and original material maps remain.
